title: event.chat (server → platform, reliable)
description: Match event (FLEET.md §8.1): a human player's chat line (say / say_team) that is not a chat command (`.` or `!`). Sent only while the server has a platform assignment; bots and the console are never sent. At most 5 lines per player per 5 s (more are dropped on the server). Envelope epoch = the assignment's. `rev` / `patch` continue the MatchState stream (see match.defs.json#/$defs/rev). There is no answer on the link.

team.description: by the assignment's roster; null = not on a team's roster (a spectator, an admin)

side.description: the player's side when they wrote the line (spec = spectators or no team yet)

message.description: the line: control bytes dropped, spaces collapsed, trimmed, at most 300 characters (UTF-8; up to 1200 bytes)

team_only.description: true = say_team (only the player's own side saw it)

at.description: when the server saw the line, Unix ms
